title: NaiveAI Promises 2,100 Tokens per Second. How Well Does It Code?
author: Gabriele Beltramo
description: NaiveAI could potentially top Artificial Analysis’s speed rankings. Our hands-on test suggests its coding quality holds up against DeepSeek.
summary: Editor’s note: With this post, we are launching a new series focused on trying new models and products with unbiased reviews. Reach out with suggestions to tips@latent.space.
takeaways: The model is an evolution of Xiaomi’s MiMo-V2.5 , which NaiveAI has trained further for long-context reasoning and paired with its own NaiveRT inference engine.

Model NL2Repo-Bench DeepSWE v1.1 Agent's Last Exam (ALE) GLM-5.3-Flash 56.3 63.4 26.3 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 68.2 77.0 35.4 Naive-N0.5-Flash 71.9 67.8 32.4 Our own evaluations below look at the differences between these models in more detail.

On the hard HLE questions, Naive-N0.5-Flash with thinking on averaged about 108,500 completion tokens, roughly nine times the GLM 5.3 Flash (high) average and 11 times the DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (high) average.
